paper.title: Reinforcement Learning from Adversarial Preferences in Tabular MDPs

settings.out_of_scope_reason: Episodic tabular MDP (reinforcement learning with state transitions), not a bandit problem.
unmapped: layered episodic MDP with S states, A actions, H steps, T episodes

settings.definition_quote: The episodic tabular MDP with adversarial losses, denoted by $\calM_{\mathsf{loss}} = \prn{ \calM, \set{\ell_t}_{t=1}^T }$ for loss function $\ell_t \colon \calS \times \calA \to [0,1]$ at episode $t \in [T]$

settings.name_in_paper: Preference-based MDPs (PbMDPs) with Borda scores (lower bound)

settings.definition_quote: a PbMDP $\calM_{\mathsf{pref}} = (\calM, \set{\Pmat_t}_{t=1}^T, \ell)$ consists of a tabular MDP $\calM$, a preference function $\Pmat_t$ ... the learner ... only observes a preference feedback $o_t(s_{t,h}, a_{t,h}^L, a_{t,h}^R) \sim \ber(\Pmat_t(s_{t,h}, a_{t,h}^L, a_{t,h}^R))$.

symbols.S_states: number of states of the MDP

source.label: thm:lower_bound_adv_loss
source.quote: Suppose that $H \geq 3$ and $A \geq 5$. Then, for any policy, there exists an episodic MDP with adversarial losses such that $\E\brk{\Reg_T} = \Omega(\sqrt{H S A T})$.

results.notes: Instance uses stochastic Bernoulli losses and uniform layered transitions; construction mentioned in Zimin & Neu 2013 but proof is new.

symbols.S_states: number of states of the MDP

source.label: thm:lower_bound_adv_pref_borda
source.quote: Suppose that $H \geq 3$ and $K \geq 5$. Then, for any policy, there exists an episodic PbMDP with Borda scores such that $\E\brk{\Reg_T} = \Omega( \prn{ H^2 S K}^{1/3} T^{2/3})$.

results.notes: Hard instance uses fixed preference matrices (stochastic Bernoulli feedback).

symbols.S_states: number of states of the MDP

source.label: thm:reg_occ_meas
source.quote: Suppose that $T \geq 8 S^2 K \log (SK) / H^2$. Then, with appropriate choices of $\eta$ and $\gamma$, \Cref{alg:pf_mdp_occ} achieves $\E\brk{\Reg_T} = O \prn*{ \prn{H^2 S^2 K}^{1/3} T^{2/3} \prn{ \log(SK) }^{1/3} }$

results.notes: Requires solving convex program over occupancy polytope each episode (polynomial but expensive). With H=S=1 recovers (K log K)^{1/3} T^{2/3} for Borda dueling bandits.

symbols.S_states: number of states of the MDP

conditions: T >= (S K^5 log K)/(alpha H^3) as stated (alpha undefined; proof uses T >= S K^5 log K / H^3)
tuning: delta = 4 eta H A K / gamma

source.label: thm:regret_po_23
source.quote: Suppose that $T \geq \prn{S K^5 \log K} / (\alpha H^3)$. Then, with appropriate choices of $c > 0$, $\eta \leq 1/(cH)$, $\gamma \in (0,1/2]$, and $\delta > 0$, \Cref{alg:pf_mdp_policy_optimization} achieves $\E\brk{\Reg_T} = \tilde{O}\prn[\big]{ (H^6 S K^5)^{1/3} T^{2/3} + H^4 T^{1/3} / \prn{S K^5}^{1/3} }.$

results.notes: Condition contains an undefined alpha (likely typo).

bound.expression_latex: \tilde{O}\prn*{ \prn*{H^7 S K^5}^{1/3} T^{2/3} + H^2 S K \sqrt{T} }

symbols.S_states: number of states of the MDP

conditions: T >= 6 H^{5/2} log K / sqrt(S K^5)

source.label: thm:regret_po_23_unk
source.quote: Suppose that $T \geq 6 H^{5/2} \log K / \sqrt{S K^5}$. Then, with appropriate choices of $c > 0$, $\gamma \in (0,1/2]$, and $\delta > 0$, \Cref{alg:pf_mdp_policy_optimization_unk} achieves $\E\brk*{\Reg_T} = \tilde{O}\prn*{ \prn*{H^7 S K^5}^{1/3} T^{2/3} + H^2 S K \sqrt{T} }.$

results.notes: Proof states a different condition on T (T >= S K^5 log K / H^3) than the theorem.
